title: ws-voice-mute (app to server)

user_id.description: A member of the Session (owner or viewer).

description: The owner of a Session mutes or unmutes a member for everyone (muted_by_host in voice_room). The flag belongs to the person and stays for the lifetime of the Session, also while the person is out of the room or rejoins. Others get forbidden, a user who is no member gets not_found. Needs together_v1.
